item.title: DuSable Black History Museum honors Black American icons past and present
item.description: Crowds filled the DuSable Black History Museum on Saturday, honoring Black Americans presently shaping history and those who've left behind legacies of greatness.

item.title: Woman found shot to death inside West Ridge home
item.description: A 36-year-old woman was found dead inside a home in West Ridge on Friday morning after suffering at least one gunshot wound, and an investigation is now underway.

item.title: Judge orders man cleared of Bovino murder-for-hire plot be released or given bond hearing by Wednesday
item.description: A federal judge in Indiana has ruled that the man cleared of accusations of offering $10,000 for the murder of Border Patrol Cmdr. Greg Bovino must be released from custody or given a bond hearing by Wednesday.

item.title: 'Wholly inappropriate': Mayor's executive order on police and immigration faces backlash from Cook County State's Attorney
item.description: Cook County State's Attorney Eileen O'Neill Burke on Friday evening criticized Mayor Brandon Johnson's executive order regarding police and immigration.

item.title: Sunday Forecast: Breezy with a big warm-up ahead
item.description: Chicagoland returns to more seasonable temperatures on Sunday, but not before a few lake effect snow showers pop up overnight across the region. Any flakes that fall should be light, but they could briefly reduce visibility for travelers.

item.title: 'Let's do what's right': Indiana lawmakers face pressure over NIPSCO rate hikes at town hall
item.description: NIPSCO customers in Indiana are urging lawmakers to take action as their energy bills continue to rise due to a rate hike approved last October.

item.title: Crews in Dixmoor fix initial water main break, second to be repaired Sunday
item.description: Dixmoor is experiencing water main breaks due to aging infrastructure and freezing temperatures, leaving approximately 50 homes without water and causing disruptions for the past two weeks.

item.title: Mother, boyfriend charged with murder in child's death
item.description: A mother and her boyfriend have been charged with murder following the death of an 8-year-old boy.
